text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Alright... I can still keep 
going...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is amazing~ I need to follow her 
example...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! For this problem, substituting into x 
using the previous formula should give the 
answer!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, correct again! You've prepared 
thoroughly for class!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, feeling good! My times are 
improving, and more and more people have 
been cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The teacher praised me too! If we keep 
this up, the primary screening will—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I'm voting, it's gotta be for 
Crown-chan~! She's flawless on and off the 
turf, so inspiring...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
I'm voting for Duramente-san! Stoic yet 
ferocious... just watching her run gives 
me chills!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, what do we do... Everyone's only 
paying attention to other girls~

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And here I thought we were 
properly showing everyone what we can do—

Nii-shishishi!! Looks like you two are in 
quite a pickle!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Teio-san?! McQueen-san?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I heard all about it. You two are aiming 
to model for the poster like we did, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
As your great upperclassman, allow me to 
impart some advice to my troubled juniors♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I'd like to say, but there might 
not actually be much to teach~ We were 
really just frantically competing against 
each other, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even with the modeling, at first I 
thought, "Why isn't it just me? I'm way, 
waaay stronger than McQueen!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I felt the same way desu wa. But that is 
precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pushing and elevating each other through 
fierce rivalry—I recall that being what 
was truly evaluated.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! Then if we show everyone how we compete 
against each other too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No. Your situation is entirely different 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Between us, who met at the academy and 
honed our skills, and you two, who have 
shared a close bond since long before 
enrolling, the circumstances are 
completely distinct.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We relentlessly dashed along our own 
individual paths to make our dreams come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you two are different. That's not 
where your true strength lies, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Our... strength...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Try thinking carefully about it—"the 
two of you together."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A strength unique to us, huh... It's true 
that we're pretty different from Teio-san 
and McQueen-san, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I was really surprised to hear 
they both initially wanted to model alone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've always talked about wanting to be 
models "together"...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Together... That's it, Dia-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We promised to fulfill our dreams 
together, walking the same path since we 
were little! It's because we're together 
that we've become this strong!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So this time too... "the two of us 
together" is the real answer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Training together really makes it 
so many times better than running alone~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hey, Kita-chan, let's run another 
lap! I won't lose this time!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl D
text_block_list.text:
Oh, running together as always! You two 
are so close.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl E
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't watching them have fun like that 
just naturally brighten your mood?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—So, we want to be the poster models 
together! Please vote for us!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl F
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that sounds perfect for you two! 
We're rooting for you! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the academy grounds, I 
witnessed that scene. It seems they are 
doing their absolute best to be nominated 
as models.
choice_data_list:
Sounds like your reputation has been great 
lately.

Sounds like your reputation has been great 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Ehehe, looks like we're properly 
bringing out "our unique strength" that 
Teio-san talked about!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We get stronger because we're together! By 
aiming for our dream side by side, we 
realized we can bring out many times more 
power than when we're alone!
choice_data_list:
Then all that's left is to deliver 
results!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly! That advice really opened up a 
whole new path for us in an instant...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We want to become capable of guiding 
others just like those two someday!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching them happily talk about their 
idols was truly heartwarming. I found 
myself looking forward to the day when 
they could stand alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With the two of us together, 
we're sure to bring out great results!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not just this time. Whatever dreams we 
pursue from now on, as long as we're 
together, I know we can overcome anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gained such wonderful insight, the 
two of them would surely make their dream 
come true—I decided to keep quietly 
cheering them on.
